question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

He has to look after his __________ aunt.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**aged**" is used to describe an older or elderly person, which fits the context of the sentence.
 
• The other options: "**age old**," "**ages**," and "**edge**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *He has to look after his aged__ aunt.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Age old (पुराना)**: Typically used to describe something that has existed for a very long time, not suitable here.
 
• **Ages (काल)**: Refers to an indefinite period of time, not suitable to describe a person.
 
• **Edge (कगार)**: Refers to the outer limit of an object, area, or surface, not relevant here.
